author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to load an artifact in the Exchange transport agent.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Exchange transport agent installation artifacts (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enumerate sensitive domain group settings and membership.
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-SAM sensitive domain user & groups enumeration.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4661 AND ProcessName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectServer='Security Account Manager' AND (ObjectName LIKE 'S-1-5-32-%' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ObjectType LIKE 'SAM\_USER' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectType LIKE 'SAM\_GROUP' ESCAPE '\') AND (ObjectName LIKE '%-500' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE '%-512' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE '%-513' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Sensitive SAM domain user & groups discovery (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker uses RDP tunneling to redirect traffic to a C&C target.
falsepositives: Nested RDP session on the same host using ::1 as destination IP
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE ((EventID=21 OR EventID=24 OR EventID=25) AND Channel='Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager/Operational' AND Address LIKE '::\%%' ESCAPE '\') OR (EventID=1149 AND Channel='Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-RemoteConnectionManager/Operational' AND Param3 LIKE '::\%%' ESCAPE '\')
title: RDP tunneling via ngrok detected

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker configure the Windows firewall to allow incoming connections to perform stealthy lateral movement.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-NetFirewallRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%LocalPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Action%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-NetFirewallRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%LocalPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Action%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-NetFirewallRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LocalPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Action%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: OpenSSH server firewall configuration on Windows (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker disabled the Windows Firewall to evade defense.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall' AND ((Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall' AND EventID=2003 AND SettingType='1' AND SettingValueString='No') OR (EventID=4950 AND SettingType='Enable Windows Firewall' AND SettingValue='No'))
title: Firewall deactivation (firewall)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
filename: windows-os/win-os-event log clear attemp using diagnostic (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Event log cleared using Diagnostics (via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a suspicious change is done on DNSadmin group in order to abuse DNSadmin privileges for DLL load.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4728 OR EventID=4756 OR EventID=4732) AND TargetUserName='DnsAdmins')
title: Member added to DNSadmin group

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker deployed a service pointing to a hidden and encoded PowerShell payload.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Encoded PowerShell payload deployed (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to retrieve SPN using PowerShell and native tools.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious SPN enumeration previous to Kerberoasting attack (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker calls the stickey key and execute CMD.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((EventID=4688 AND Version=2 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (EventID=1 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sethc.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%utilman.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osk.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Magnify.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Narrator.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisplaySwitch.exe%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Stickey key called CMD via command execution

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker removes security protection from a sensitive account to escalate privileges
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-user set as sensitive had protection removed.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4738 AND UserAccountControl LIKE '\%\%2062' ESCAPE '\')
title: Account marked as sensitive and cannot be delegated had its protection removed (weakness introduction)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to create a service for persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Service creation (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker deployed a service pointing to a hidden and encoded PowerShell payload. Some parameters are commented in case you would like to reduce false positives or make the rule more precise.
filename: windows-os/win-os-payload encoded PowerShell deployed via service.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%gnirtS46esaBmorF%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%gnirtS46esaBmorF%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Encoded PowerShell payload deployed via service

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a threat exclusion is added to the antivirus in order to bypass its detection capacities
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender threat exclusion added (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if a member is added to a local group via PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Group%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Member%' ESCAPE '\')) OR EventID='4103 - ''Add-LocalGroupMember'' - ''-Group'' - ''-Member''' OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Group%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Member%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Local group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enable Wdgiest authention so passwords are stored in clear text and can be dumped.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SecurityProviders\\WDigest%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%UseLogonCredential%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Wdigest authentication enabled (Reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker would attempt to shadow a RDP session.
falsepositives: administrative source host used for shadowing
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mstsc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%mstsc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/shadow%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: RDP shadow session started (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if a member is added to a domain group via PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Identity%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Members%' ESCAPE '\')) OR EventID='4103 - ''Add-ADGroupMember'' - ''-Identity'' - ''-Members''' OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Identity%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Members%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Domain group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the permissions of a service using native PowerShell commands in order to abuse its privileges. Note that it requires PowerShell 7 or higher.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service permissions hijacked for privileges abuse (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker disabled the Windows Firewall to evade defense.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((Commandline LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%state%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%off%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Commandline LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '% a%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '% s%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%state%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%off%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Firewall deactivation (modern command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to spoof the SAM account name of a a domain controller in order to impersonate it. Vulnerability comes from that computer accounts should have a trailing $ in their name (i.e. sAMAccountName attribute) but no validation process existed until the patch was released. During the offensive phase, attacker will create and rename the sAMAccountName of a computer account to look like the one of a domain controller.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4768 AND Status=0 AND ServiceSid LIKE '%-502' ESCAPE '\') OR (EventID=4769 AND Status=0 AND ServiceName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((TargetUserName LIKE '%$%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Kerberos ticket without a trailing $ (CVE-2021-42278/42287)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a firewall rule any/any is added to allow any incoming or outgoing traffic.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall' AND (((EventID=2004 OR EventID=2005) AND `Action`=3) AND ((LocalPorts LIKE '%' ESCAPE '\' AND RemotePorts LIKE '%' ESCAPE '\') OR (LocalAddresses LIKE '%' ESCAPE '\' AND RemoteAddresses LIKE '%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Firewall rule any/any created

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker createsan instance of a WMI class using tools like WMImplant or PowerLurk.
falsepositives: Microsoft System Center or security products
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: WMI registration (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker reset or synchronize with another domain account the DSRM (Directory Services Restore Mode) password in order to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: DSRM password changed (Reg via PowerShell)

author: Emir Erdogan (shortly adapted by mdecrevoisier)
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuse the printer spooler features to load a DLL. The attack is composed by 4 steps > 1) create a printer that points to a missing DLL 2) print to that port 3) crash the printer spool 4) have his original DLL registered for privilege escalation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Print spooler privilege escalation via printer added (CVE-2020-1048)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modifies host delegation settings for privilege escalation.
falsepositives: Rare administrator modifying host delegation settings
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4742 AND UserAccountControl LIKE '\%\%2093' ESCAPE '\')
title: Host unconstrained delegation settings changed for potential abuse (Rubeus)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuse the at command to elevate privilages. Note that at command is deprecated since Windows 8 and replaced by schtask.
filename: windows-scheduled_task/win-os-scheduled task triggers interactive shell (at, deprecated).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%at%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%interactive%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Interactive privileged shell triggered by schedule task (deprecated)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker enables a disabled builtin account via command line.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%active%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%yes%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Guest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DefaultAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%support\_388945a0%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HelpAssistant%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WDAGUtilityAccount%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Disabled guest or builtin account activated (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker execute the Impacket DCOMexec tool in order to abuse DCOM services.
falsepositives: rare administrator modifications of DCOM settings
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4674 AND ProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ObjectName LIKE '\\BaseNamedObjects\\HWNDInterface:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE '\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SYSTEM\\ControlSet001\\Services\\WinSock2\\Parameters%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Impacket DCOMexec privilege abuse via MMC

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
filename: windows-os/win-os-event log clear attemp using diagnostic (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Event log cleared using Diagnostics (via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a threat exclusion is added to the antivirus in order to bypass its detection capacities
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender threat exclusion added (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to register the SMBexec service to estasblish persistence. Note that service registration is not always performed and that is recommended to use the related registry SYSMON rule to increase detection reliability.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4697 OR EventID=7045) AND ServiceName='BTOBTO')
title: Impacket SMBexec service registration (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker cleared the event logs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=1102 OR EventID=104)
title: Event log cleared (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the configuration of a service to trigger an action when the service is crashed.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with backdoored command failure (Reg via PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service abuse with backdoored "command failure" (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enable the Image File Execution Options (IFEO) debugger for sethc.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Debugger%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Stickey key IFEO (Reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuse MachineAccountQuota privilege and pre-create a computer object for abusing RBCD delegation.
falsepositives: Windows Autopilot Hybrid Azure AD Join
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-computer account created by a computer account.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4741 AND SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' AND SubjectUserSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious computer account created by a computer account

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to alter certificate chain validation by installing a root CA.
falsepositives: Administrator manually adding a root CA
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Commandline LIKE '%-dspublish%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%.crt%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%NTAuthCA%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Certutil root certificate installation

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enumerate or to establish a connection to a network share.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%share%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Network share manipulation via commandline

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to abuse certutil command to download obfuscated malicious payload using the Tchopper tool.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND Version=2 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%decode%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Certutil payload obfuscation - Tchopper (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the permissions of a service using native PowerShell commands in order to abuse its privileges. Note that it requires PowerShell 7 or higher.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service permissions hijacked for privileges abuse (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enumerate local users via commandline.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%domain%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: User properties enumeration via commandline

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker configure port forwarding on a host to redirect traffic to a C&C target.
filename: windows-rdp/win-rdp-tunneling configuration enabled for port forwarding (command).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (((Commandline LIKE '%interface%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%portproxy%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Commandline LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' OR Commandline LIKE '%reset%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((Commandline LIKE '%i %' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%p %' ESCAPE '\') AND (Commandline LIKE '%a %' ESCAPE '\' OR Commandline LIKE '%r %' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: RDP tunneling configuration enabled for port forwarding

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modifies host delegation settings for privilege escalation.
falsepositives: Rare administrator modifying host delegation settings
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4742 AND UserAccountControl LIKE '\%\%2093' ESCAPE '\')
title: Host set with unconstrained delegation

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempt read the Hosts file content via network share.
filename: windows-os/win-os-hosts file accessed via network share.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\C$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE 'Windows\\System32\\Drivers\\etc\\hosts' ESCAPE '\')
title: DNS hosts file accessed via network share

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker deployed a service pointing to a hidden and encoded PowerShell payload.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Encoded PowerShell payload deployed (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker inject a payload into SQL Server in order to obtain a remote shell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sqlservr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%echo%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-c%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Metasploit reverse shell injection in SQL Server

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to access vault credentials.
filename: windows-os/win-os-Fortinet APT group abuse on Windows (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Vault credentials manager accessed

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to create a user via commandline.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%net%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: User creation via commandline

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker execute the Impacket DCOMexec tool in order to abuse DCOM services.
falsepositives: rare administrator modifications of DCOM settings
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((EventID=4688 AND Version=2 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (EventID=1 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Impacket DCOMexec process abuse via MMC

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker would attempt to escalate privileges by changing the security settings of the responder.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventID=5124
title: OCSP responder security settings changed

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Event log clear attempt (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module via Global Assembly cache (GAC) manipulation.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
filename: windows-iis/win-iis-web module loaded via GAC manipulation (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Webserver IIS module installed via GAC manipulation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to load an artifact in the Exchange transport agent.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Exchange transport agent installation artifacts (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker creates a user account that fakes a computer account.
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-user account creation disguised in a computer account.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4720 AND TargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\') OR ((EventID=4781 AND NewTargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((OldTargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: User account creation disguised in a computer account

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enumerate or to establish a connection to a network share.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%net view%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%net use%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Network share discovery and/or connection via commandline

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker cleared the event logs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (EventID=1102 OR EventID=104)
title: Event log cleared (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if an attacker logs on using the serial console.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4624 AND LogonProcess LIKE '%sacsess.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND LogonType=2)
title: Azure Windows virtual machine login via serial console

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to abuse certutil command to download obfuscated malicious payload. Tools like Tchopper can trigger this rule.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%decode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%encodehex%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%decodehex%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Certutil payload obfuscation (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to escalate privilege by adding a user to a group via commandline.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: User added to a group via commandline

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker used a forged Golden ticket to login on a remote host. Per default or if specified, the ticket will be forged using the builtin administrator account (SID *-500). However, and it frequent cases, a non suspicious user name will be specificied during the forge in order to evade security monitoring. The rule works based on this trick.
falsepositives: login with renamed builtin administrator account ("administrator" renamed to "admin_org")
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-login with administrator forged Golden Ticket.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4624 AND TargetUserSid LIKE '%-500' ESCAPE '\' AND LogonProcessName='Kerberos') AND (NOT COALESCE((TargetUserName='Administrator' OR TargetUserName='Järjestelmänvalvoja' OR TargetUserName='Administrateur' OR TargetUserName='Administrador' OR TargetUserName='Administratör' OR TargetUserName='Rendszergazda' OR TargetUserName='Администратор'), 0)))
title: Administrator login impersonation with forged Golden ticket

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the permissions of a service using native PowerShell commands in order to abuse its privileges. Note that it requires PowerShell 7 or higher.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND EventData REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND Payload REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service permissions hijacked for privileges abuse (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to dump the LSASS process content using a renamed version of the Procdump tool.
filename: windows-os/win-os-procdump tool renamed and used for dumping LSASS process.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procdump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFilename='procdump.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%accepteula%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-ma%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Renamed Procdump tool used for dumping LSASS process

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker remotely dump LSASS credentials using the LSASSY tool.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4656 OR EventID=4663) AND ObjectType='Process' AND ObjectServer='Security' AND ProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: LSASS credential dump with LSASSY (kernel access)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker disable or reduce the size of an event log.
filename: windows-os/win-os-event log disabled or size reduced (command).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/e:false%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/ms:%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Event log deactivation or size reduction (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the original service executable path with a malicious one.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via command).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module via Global Assembly cache (GAC) manipulation.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
filename: windows-iis/win-iis-web module loaded via GAC manipulation (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Webserver IIS module installed via GAC manipulation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker execute the Impacket DCOMexec tool in order to abuse DCOM services.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: DCOM lateral movement (via MMC20)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disable Defender security features by modifying service configuration in registry.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=13 AND EventType='SetValue' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\wscsvc\\Start' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\SecurityHealthService\\Start' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\Sense\\Start' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\WdBoot\\Start' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\WdFilter\\Start' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\WdNisDrv\\Start' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\WdNisSvc\\Start' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\WinDefend\\Start' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%0x00000003%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%0x00000004%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Microsoft Defender service components status disabled (Registry via Sysmon)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to escalate privileges while abusing KrbRelayUp attack.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (EventID=7045 AND ServiceName='KrbSCM')
title: KrbRelayUp service installation (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker configure the Windows firewall to allow incoming connections to perform stealthy lateral movement.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-NetFirewallRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%LocalPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Action%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-NetFirewallRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%LocalPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Action%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-NetFirewallRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LocalPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Action%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: OpenSSH server firewall configuration on Windows (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker reset or synchronize with another domain account the DSRM (Directory Services Restore Mode) password in order to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventID=4794
title: DSRM password changed (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the permissions of a service using native PowerShell commands in order to abuse its privileges. Note that it requires PowerShell 7 or higher.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND EventData REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND Payload REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service permissions hijacked for privileges abuse (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker installs the Mimikatz driver to bypass the LSA protected mode (RunAsPPL) and dump LSASS process content.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\mimidrv%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Mimikatz driver registration (Reg via Sysmon)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker failed to replace the original sethc.exe file by cmd.exe.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4656 AND ObjectServer='Security' AND ObjectType='File' AND ObjectName LIKE '%sethc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ProcessName LIKE '%cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND EventType LIKE 'AUDIT\_FAILURE' ESCAPE '\' AND AccessReason LIKE '%\%4417: \%\%1805%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Sticky key sethc file failed replacement

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker adds a reference in the registry to a malicious SSP (Security Support Provider). Note that this rule will not work with "in memory" SSP injection (Mimikatz).
filename: windows-os/win-os-security package (SSP) reference added (Reg via command).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Security Packages%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Security package (SSP) added (Reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker update the Service Principal Name (SPN) of a computer account in order to perform "Kerberos redirection" and escalate privileges.
falsepositives: Rare administrator modifications on user objects
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-spn modification of a computer account (DCshadow) (Directory Services).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='servicePrincipalName' AND ObjectClas='computer' AND OperationType LIKE '\%\%14674' ESCAPE '\' AND AttributeValue LIKE 'GC/%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious modification of a fake domain controller SPN (DCshadow) (Directory Services)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disable Defender security features
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Microsoft Defender critical security components disabled (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if a member is added to a local group via PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Group%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Member%' ESCAPE '\')) OR EventID='4103 - ''Add-LocalGroupMember'' - ''-Group'' - ''-Member''' OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Group%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Member%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Local group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disbale or clear the audit policy for defense evasion purposes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\auditpol.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%clear%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Audit policy disabled by command line

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker would attempt to alter or disable OCSP responder auditing settings to evade detection and perform further escalation via ADCS vulnerabilities.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5123 AND PropertyName='AuditFilter')
title: OCSP responder auditing settings changed or disabled

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker loads a malicious SSP (Security Support Provider) into the LSA process. Note that this rule will not work with "in memory" SSP injection (Mimikatz) as no event will be triggered.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4622 AND (NOT COALESCE((SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\cloudAP.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\kerberos.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\lsasrv.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\msv1\_0.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\negoexts.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\pku2u.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\schannel.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\tspkg.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR SecurityPackageName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\wdigest.dll%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Security package (SSP) loaded into LSA (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enumerate the password policy via commandline.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%accounts%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/do%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Password policy discovery via commandline

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker compromise a server with high privileges to perform permissions changes. PrivExchange attack can be detected using this rule.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='ntSecurityDescriptor' AND OperationType LIKE '\%\%14674' ESCAPE '\' AND (SubjectUserName='srvexchange01$' OR SubjectUserName='srvexchange02$' OR SubjectUserName='srvexchange03$'))
title: Computer account modifying Active Directory permissions (PrivExchange)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to exploit the BlueKeep vulnerability.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=148 AND Channel='Microsoft-Windows-RemoteDesktopServices-RdpCoreTS/Operational' AND ChannelName LIKE 'ms\_t120' ESCAPE '\'
title: RDP BlueeKeep connection closed (CVE-2019-0708)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a threat exclusion is added to the antivirus in order to bypass its detection capacities
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND (EventID=5007 AND NewValue LIKE 'HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Microsoft Defender threat exclusion added (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%clear-log%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cl%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Event log clear attempt (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempt to dump browser credentials (Firefox, Google Chrome, ...) via network share.
filename: windows-browser/win-browser-credentials dump via network share (DonPapi, Lazagne).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\C$' ESCAPE '\') AND ((RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles\\' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\edge-cookies.json' ESCAPE '\') OR (RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\Default\\Cookies\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: User browser credentials dump via network share (DonPapi, Lazagne)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker used a forged Golden ticket to login on a remote shared folder. Per default or if specified, the ticket will be forged using the builtin administrator account (SID *-500). However, and it frequent cases, a non suspicious user name will be specificied during the forge in order to evade security monitoring. The rule works based on this trick.
falsepositives: login with renamed builtin administrator account ("administrator" renamed to "admin_org")
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-share access with administrator forged Golden Ticket.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=5140 OR EventID=5145) AND SubjectUserSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21%' ESCAPE '\' AND SubjectUserSid LIKE '%-500' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName='Administrator' OR SubjectUserName='Järjestelmänvalvoja' OR SubjectUserName='Administrateur' OR SubjectUserName='Administrador' OR SubjectUserName='Administratör' OR SubjectUserName='Rendszergazda' OR SubjectUserName='Администратор'), 0)))
title: Shared folder access with forged Golden ticket

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to remotely execute WMIexec via SMB admin share in order to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\ADMIN$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName REGEXP '__\d*\.\d*')
title: Impacket WMIexec execution via SMB admin share

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to execute WMIexec in order to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\127.0.0.1\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/Q%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/C%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\127.0.0.1\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Q%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/C%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Impacket WMIexec process execution

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker updates the Service Principal Name (SPN) of a fake domain controller account in order to perform DCshadow attack.
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-spn modification of a computer account (DCshadow).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4742 AND ServicePrincipalNames LIKE '%GC/%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Suspicious modification of a fake domain controller SPN (DCshadow)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker execute Secretdump in order to remotely dump credentials over SMB.
filename: windows-os/win-os-impacket secret dump via SMB admin share.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\ADMIN$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE 'SYSTEM32%' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE '%.tmp' ESCAPE '\')
title: Secretdump password dumping via SMB admin share

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker exploits the PrintNightmare vulnerability and obtained a CMD shell.
filename: windows-os/win-os-printer process spawned a CMD shell (PrintNightMare).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((EventID=4688 AND Version=2 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (EventID=1 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Spool process spawned a CMD shell (PrintNightmare vulnerability - CVE-2021-36958)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module via PowerShell.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Webserver IIS module installed (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker uses sqlcmd utility to escalate privileges or introduce weaknesses.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sqlcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\osql.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Q%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: SQL server sqlcmd utility abuse for privilege escalation

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker perform a password reset event. This does not require any knowledge of a user’s current password, but it does require to have the "Reset Password" right. Correlate the event ID 4724, 4624 and 5145 using the "SubjectLogonId" field to identify the source of the reset.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4724 AND TargetSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\' AND SubjectUserSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\IPC$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName='samr') AND (EventID=4624 AND AuthenticationPackageName='NTLM')) AND (NOT COALESCE((IpAddress='127.0.0.1' OR IpAddress='::1'), 0)))
title: User password change without previous password known - SetNTLM (Mimikatz)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuses the Netsh DLL feature to perform some code execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Commandline LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%helper%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Netsh helper DLL abuse (process)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to delete existing VSS backup via WMI.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: VSS backup deletion via WMI (Powershell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the permissions of a service using native PowerShell commands in order to abuse its privileges. Note that it requires PowerShell 7 or higher.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SecurityDescriptorSddl%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service permissions hijacked for privileges abuse (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker creates a privileged task to establish persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%tr%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%sc%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Scheduled persistent task with SYSTEM privileges creation

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuses the Netsh DLL feature to perform some code execution.
filename: windows-os/win-os-netsh helper DLL registration abuse (Reg via Sysmon).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\NetSh' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Netsh helper DLL abuse (Reg via Sysmon)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker would abuse some privileges while realying host credentials to escalate privileges.
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-user account created by a computer account.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4720 AND SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' AND SubjectUserSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\')
title: User account created by a computer account

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a suspicious group membership is changed.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4728 OR EventID=4756) AND TargetSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetSid LIKE '%-512' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-518' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-519' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-520' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-526' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-527' ESCAPE '\'))
title: High risk Active Directory group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to create a service for persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service creation (PowerShell)

author: Emir Erdogan (shortly adapted by mdecrevoisier)
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuse the printer spooler features to load a DLL. The attack is composed by 4 steps > 1) create a printer that points to a missing DLL 2) print to that port 3) crash the printer spool 4) have his original DLL registered for privilege escalation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Print spooler privilege escalation via printer added (CVE-2020-1048)

author: mdecrevoisier (adapted from Tim Rauch and Grzegorz Tworek feedback)
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFilename='appcmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%list%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%apppool%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: IIS Application Pool credential dumping

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to delete existing VSS backup via WMI.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: VSS backup deletion via WMI (Powershell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker create a service that triggers TSCON in order to preform local RDP session hijack.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%tscon %' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%/dest:rdp-%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%tscon %' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%/dest:rdp-%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: RDP session hijack via service creation abuse

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the configuration of a service to trigger an action when the service is crashed.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with backdoored command failure (Reg via PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service abuse with backdoored "command failure" (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module via the gacutil tool.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gacutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Webserver IIS module installed (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker set an account with reversible encryption to facilitate brutforce or cracking operations.
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-user set with reversible password encryption.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4738 AND UserAccountControl LIKE '\%\%2091' ESCAPE '\')
title: Account set with reversible encryption (weakness introduction)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module via PowerShell.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Webserver IIS module installed (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker having compromised a virtual machine via serial cable attempts to enumerate local groups.
filename: windows-azure/win-os-local group enumeration via Azure Virtual machine recovery tool.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4799 AND CallerProcessName LIKE '%Microsoft.Compute.VMAccessAgent%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Local group enumeration triggered by Azure Virtual machine recovery tool

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker adds a SPN to an account in order to perform different type of abuse (Kerberoast, delegation abuse, ...)
falsepositives: SPN linked to a load balancer
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\setspn.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-s %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: SPN added to an account by command line

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker update the Service Principal Name (SPN) of a user account in order to enable Kerberoast attack and crack its password.
falsepositives: Rare administrator modifications on user objects
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-spn modification of a user account (Kerberoasting).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='servicePrincipalName' AND ObjectClass='user' AND OperationType LIKE '\%\%14674' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((AttributeValue='-'), 0)))
title: Suspicious modification of a user account SPN to enable Kerberoast attack

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker grants replication privilege to an account to exflitrate Active Directory credentials
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='ntSecurityDescriptor' AND OperationType LIKE '\%\%14674' ESCAPE '\' AND (AttributeValue LIKE '%1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2%' ESCAPE '\' OR AttributeValue LIKE '%1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2%' ESCAPE '\' OR AttributeValue LIKE '%89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Replication privileges granted to perform DCSync attack

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker resets a user account by using the compromised NTLM password hash. The newly clear text password defined by the attacker can be then used in order to login into services like Outlook Web Access (OWA), RDP, SharePoint... As ID 4723 refers to user changing is own password, the SubjectSid and TargetSid should be equal. However in a change initiated by Mimikatz, they will be different. Correlate the event ID 4723, 4624 and 5145 using the "SubjectLogonId" field to identify the source of the reset.
falsepositives: Admin changing is own account directly using the Active Directory console and not the GUI (ctrl alt suppr)
ADFS, MSOL, DirSync, Azure AD Sync
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4723 AND TargetSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\' AND SubjectUserSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\')
title: User password change using current hash password - ChangeNTLM (Mimikatz)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to replace the original sethc.exe file by cmd.exe.
filename: windows-os/win-os-sticky key sethc command for replacement by CMD.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%copy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%sethc.exe%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Sticky key sethc command for replacement by CMD

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker configures BitLocker for ransomware purposes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\FVE%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPMKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPMPIN%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPMKeyPIN%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RecoveryKeyMessage%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EnableBDEWithNoTPM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseAdvancedStartup%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RecoveryKeyMessageSource%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: BitLocker feature configuration (Reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker execute the Impacket DCOMexec tool in order to abuse DCOM services.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: DCOM lateral movement (via MMC20)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker download a payload using PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Payload downloaded via PowerShell

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to change Defender default action to allow any threats
