rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender default action changed to allow any threat (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker disabled the Windows Firewall to evade defense.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Firewall deactivation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to spoof the SAM account name of a a domain controller in order to impersonate it. Vulnerability comes from that computer accounts should have a trailing $ in their name (i.e. sAMAccountName attribute) but no validation process existed until the patch was released. During the offensive phase, attacker will create and rename the sAMAccountName of a computer account to look like the one of a domain controller. Once the attack is done, attacker will rollback the sAMAccountName to its original name.
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-computer account renamed without a trailing $ (CVE-2021-42278).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4781 AND ((OldTargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewTargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0))) OR (NewTargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((OldTargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))))
title: Computer account renamed without a trailing $ (CVE-2021-42278/42287)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempt to dump Azure Active Directory Connect credentials via network share.
filename: windows-azure/win-os-AD Connect credentials dump via network share.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\C$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Windows\\ServiceProfiles\\ADSync\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Azure Active Directory Connect credentials dump via network share

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker configure the Windows firewall to allow incoming connections to perform stealthy lateral movement.

title: OpenSSH server firewall configuration on Windows (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker changed the IFEO settings related to sethc.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND ((EventID=13 AND EventType='SetValue' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\sethc.exe\\Debugger' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\Magnify.exe\\Debugger' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\Narrator.exe\\Debugger' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\utilman.exe\\Debugger' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\DisplaySwitch.exe\\Debugger' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\osk.exe\\Debugger' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=12 AND EventType='CreateKey' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\sethc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\Magnify.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\Narrator.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\utilman.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\DisplaySwitch.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\osk.exe' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Stickey key IFEO registry changed (Reg via Sysmon)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker changes permissions on the AdminSDHolder container to establish persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5136 AND OperationType LIKE '\%\%14674' ESCAPE '\' AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='nTSecurityDescriptor' AND ObjectDN LIKE 'CN=AdminSDHolder,CN=System,%' ESCAPE '\')
title: AdminSDHolder permissions changed for persistence

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if a member is added to a local group via PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Group%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Member%' ESCAPE '\')) OR EventID='4103 - ''Add-LocalGroupMember'' - ''-Group'' - ''-Member''' OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Group%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Member%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Local group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker reset or synchronize with another domain account the DSRM (Directory Services Restore Mode) password in order to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: DSRM password changed (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to extract current Windows firewall configuration to prepare an attack.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((Commandline LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%show%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Commandline LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%show%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '% a%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Firewall configuration enumerated (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to retrieve SPN using PowerShell and native tools.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious SPN enumeration previous to Kerberoasting attack (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker uses RDP tunneling to redirect traffic to a C&C target.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1149 AND Channel='Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-RemoteConnectionManager/Operational' AND Param3='127.0.0.1'
title: RDP tunneling detected

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a suspicious group membership is changed. Having Microsoft LAPS installed may trigger false positive events for the builtin administrators group triggered by the system account (S-1-5-18).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4732 AND TargetSid LIKE 'S-1-5-32%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetSid LIKE '%-544' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-547' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-548' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-549' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-551' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetSid LIKE '%-578' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserSid='S-1-5-18'), 0)))
title: High risk local/domain local group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to delete existing VSS backup via WMI.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Rcim%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: VSS backup deletion via WMI (Powershell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%wmic%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%cleareventlog%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Event log clear attempt (wmi)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker executes Chrome in headless mode in order to download a payload. Document Object Model (DOM) may also be abused to download obfuscated data from attacker repositary.
filename: windows-browser/win-browser-Edge & Chrome abuse to download payload via console.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--dump-dom%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--headless%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Edge/Chrome headless feature abuse for payload download

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuses the WinRS capacities for remote execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\winrs.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-r:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/r:%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: WinRS usage for remote execution

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to abuse certutil command to download obfuscated malicious payload.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%urlcache%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Certutil payload download (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to access vault credentials.
filename: windows-os/win-os-Fortinet APT group abuse on Windows (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Vault credentials manager accessed

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker disabled the Windows Firewall to evade defense.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Firewall deactivation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to load an artifact in the Exchange transport agent.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='MSExchange Management' AND ((EventID=1 OR EventID=6) AND (EventData LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Exchange transport agent installation artifacts (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to access vault credentials.
filename: windows-os/win-os-Fortinet APT group abuse on Windows (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Retrieve%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Vault credentials manager accessed

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuse RPC, NTLM relay and others components to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4624 AND TargetUserSid='S-1-5-7' AND LogonType=3 AND AuthenticationPackageName='NTLM' AND IpAddress='127.0.0.1') AND (EventID=4688 AND SubjectUserSid='S-1-5-18' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Anonymous login (RottenPotatoNG)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to create a service that triggers TSCON in order to preform local RDP session hijack.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%tscon%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%dest:rdp-%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: RDP session hijack via TSCON abuse command

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker disabled the Windows Firewall to evade defense.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((Commandline LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%opmode%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Commandline LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '% f%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '% s%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '% o%' ESCAPE '\' AND Commandline LIKE '% d%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Firewall deactivation (deprecated command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attemptes to download a payload directly via console.
filename: windows-browser/win-browser-Edge abuse to download payload via console.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND Version=2 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%www.%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Edge abuse for payload download via console

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the configuration of a service to trigger an action when the service is crashed.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with backdoored command failure (Reg via command).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Service abuse with backdoored "command failure" (Reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker deployed an encoded PowerShell payload via a process execution. Some parameters are commented in case you would like to reduce false positives or make the rule more precise.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%[System.Convert]::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Encoded PowerShell payload deployed via process execution

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Event log clear attempt (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker would enable shadow configuratin via registry. Note that this alert does not report the created Key and that further verification on hosts will be required to confirm the behavior.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\Terminal Services' ESCAPE '\')
title: RDP shadow session configuration enabled (registry)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to change Defender default action to allow any threats
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender default action changed to allow any threat (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker exploit the PrintNightmare vulnerability by abusing the Windows print spooler using the service exposed by Gentilkiwi
filename: windows-os/win-os-SystemNightmare by GentilKiwi - new device added (native).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=6416 AND (DeviceDescription LIKE '%printnightmare%' ESCAPE '\' OR DeviceDescription LIKE '%gentil%' ESCAPE '\' OR DeviceDescription LIKE '%kiwi%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: SystemNightmare by GentilKiwi - New external device added (CVE-2021-1675 / CVE-2021-34527)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker starts SQL Server service in single mode to perform password recovery actions using, for example, the native sqlcmd tool. Indeed, when the SQL Server is started in single user mode, all the users who are a member of the host’s local administrator group can connect to the SQL instance.
filename: windows-sql_server/sql_server-SQL Server started in single mode (command).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%MSSQL$%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-m%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: SQL Server started in single mode (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker configure the Windows firewall to allow incoming connections to perform stealthy lateral movement.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall' AND (EventID=2004 AND (ApplicationPath LIKE '%\\sshd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR LocalPorts=22))
title: OpenSSH server firewall configuration on Windows (firewall)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modifies host delegation settings for privilege escalation.
falsepositives: Rare administrator modifying host delegation settings
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-Kerberos constrained delegation settings changed (Rubeus) - Any protocol.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4742 AND UserAccountControl LIKE '\%\%2098' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((AllowedToDelegateTo='-'), 0)))
title: Host constrained delegation settings changed for potential abuse (Rubeus) - Any protocol

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker create a service that triggers TSCON in order to preform local RDP session hijack.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%tscon %' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%/dest:rdp-%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%tscon %' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%/dest:rdp-%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: RDP session hijack via service creation abuse

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker createsan instance of a WMI class using tools like WMImplant or PowerLurk.
falsepositives: Microsoft System Center or security products
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: WMI registration (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker execute the Impacket DCOMexec tool in order to abuse DCOM services.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Activator]%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CreateInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GetTypeFromProgID%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MMC20.Application%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: DCOM lateral movement (via MMC20)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker execute a remote shell via the admin share.
filename: windows-os/win-os-remote shell execution via SMB admin share.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\ADMIN$' ESCAPE '\' AND (RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote shell execution via SMB admin share

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker disabled the Windows Firewall to evade defense.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%False%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Firewall deactivation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to retrieve SPN using PowerShell and native tools.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious SPN enumeration previous to Kerberoasting attack (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker deployed a service pointing to a hidden and encoded PowerShell payload.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.StreamReader%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.Compression.%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Encoded PowerShell payload deployed (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker installs the Mimikatz driver to bypass the LSA protected mode (RunAsPPL) and dump LSASS process content.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((EventID=4697 OR EventID=7045) AND (ServiceName LIKE '%mimidrv%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%mimikatz%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Mimikatz driver deployed via service

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker use DCSync or SecretDump tool to exfiltrate Active Directory credentials
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4662 AND AccessMask=256 AND (Properties LIKE '%1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Properties LIKE '%1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Properties LIKE '%89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Replication privileges accessed to perform DCSync attack

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker rename a non admin account in order to evade SOC & operations vigilance
falsepositives: builtin admin account renamed for obfuscation
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-user renamed to admin to bypass vigilance.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4781 AND ((NewTargetUserName LIKE 'admin-%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewTargetUserName LIKE 'adm-%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewTargetUserName LIKE '<customer pattern>%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewTargetUserName LIKE '%-admin' ESCAPE '\' OR NewTargetUserName LIKE '%-adm' ESCAPE '\' OR NewTargetUserName LIKE '%<customer pattern>' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((OldTargetUserName LIKE 'admin-%' ESCAPE '\' OR OldTargetUserName LIKE 'adm-%' ESCAPE '\' OR OldTargetUserName LIKE '<customer pattern>%' ESCAPE '\') OR (OldTargetUserName LIKE '%-admin' ESCAPE '\' OR OldTargetUserName LIKE '%-adm' ESCAPE '\' OR OldTargetUserName LIKE '%<customer pattern>' ESCAPE '\') OR TargetSid LIKE '%-500' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Account renamed to admin (or likely) account to evade defense

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuses the Windows "system failure and recovery" capacities (CrashControl) to store information or to establish persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmiprvse.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND EventType='SetValue' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\AutoReboot' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\CrashDumpEnabled' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\DumpFile' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\KernelDumpOnly' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\LogEvent' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\MiniDumpDir' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\Overwrite' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl\\SendAlert' ESCAPE '\')))
title: System crash behavior manipulation - WMImplant (registry)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disable
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disabled%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Service deactivation (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker reset or synchronize with another domain account the DSRM (Directory Services Restore Mode) password in order to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: DSRM password changed (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to delete existing VSS backup.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%shadowcopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: VSS backup deletion (WMI)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disable Defender security features in PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Payload LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender critical security components disabled (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to register the SMBexec service to estasblish persistence. Note that service registration is not always performed and that is recommended to use the related registry SYSMON rule to increase detection reliability.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((EventID=4697 OR EventID=7045) AND ServiceName='BTOBTO')
title: Impacket SMBexec service registration (native)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a new member is added to a sensitive administration group related to OCS/Lync/Skype for Business in order to scan topology, infiltrate servers and move laterally.
falsepositives: OCS/Lync/Skype administrator updating server configuration or topology
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4728 OR EventID=4756 OR EventID=4732) AND (TargetUserName='CSArchivingAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='CSUserAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='RTCHSUniversalServices' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalGlobalWriteGroup' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalSBATechnicians'))
title: New member added to a "OCS/Lync/Skype for Business" administration group (medium risk)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempt to dump the LSASS process via the Task Manager.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4663 AND ProcessName LIKE '%\\taskmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Task Manager used for LSASS dump (kernel)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module via PowerShell.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-WebGlobalModule%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Image%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Webserver IIS module installed (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the permissions of a service in order to abuse its privileges
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security'))
title: Service permissions hijacked for privileges abuse (reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker installs the Mimikatz driver to bypass the LSA protected mode (RunAsPPL) and dump LSASS process content.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4697 OR EventID=7045) AND (ServiceName LIKE '%mimidrv%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%mimikatz%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Mimikatz driver deployed via service

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker accessed attributes related to DCshadow attack in order to create a fake domain controller.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4662 AND (Properties LIKE '%1131f6ac-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Properties LIKE '%9923a32a-3607-11d2-b9be-0000f87a36b2%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Account accessed to attributes related to DCshadow

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker createsan instance of a WMI class using tools like WMImplant or PowerLurk.
falsepositives: Microsoft System Center or security products
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Class%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Namespace%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Arguments%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: WMI registration (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts disbaled the audit policy for defense evasion purposes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4719 AND (AuditPolicyChanges LIKE '%\%\%8448%' ESCAPE '\' OR AuditPolicyChanges LIKE '%\%\%8450%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Audit policy disabled by command line

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if an attacker open a privileged CMD shell while accessing to an Azure virtual machine via serial cable.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sacsess.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Serial console process spawning CMD shell (via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to retrieve SPN using commandline and native tools.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\setspn.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Q%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious SPN enumeration previous to Kerberoasting attack (native commands)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where APT actors exploits Fortinet vulnerabilities to gain access into Windows infrastructure.
filename: windows-scheduled_task/win-os-Fortinet APT group abuse on Windows (task).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4698 AND TaskName LIKE '%\\SynchronizeTimeZone' ESCAPE '\')
title: Fortinet APT group abuse on Windows (task)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects Blacklotus HTTP downloader injection into winlogon.exe process.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND DestinationPort=80))
title: Winlogon process contact to C2 - Blacklotus (Sysmon)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disable Defender security features in PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Payload LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender critical security components disabled (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker creates a computer account with privileges for later exploitation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4741 AND (NOT COALESCE((PrivilegeList='-'), 0)))
title: Computer account created with privileges

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker download a payload using PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Payload downloaded via PowerShell

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the original service executable path with a malicious one.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if a member is added to a domain group via PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Identity%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Members%' ESCAPE '\')) OR EventID='4103 - ''Add-ADGroupMember'' - ''-Identity'' - ''-Members''' OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Identity%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Members%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Domain group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the permissions of a service using native PowerShell commands in order to abuse its privileges. Note that it requires PowerShell 7 or higher.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND EventData REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND Payload REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.*\\Security' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Security%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service permissions hijacked for privileges abuse (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a threat exclusion is added to the antivirus in order to bypass its detection capacities
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionPath%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionExtension%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ExclusionIpAddress%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender threat exclusion added (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
filename: windows-os/win-os-event log clear attemp using diagnostic (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Event log cleared using Diagnostics (via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a new member is added to a sensitive administration group related to OCS/Lync/Skype for Business in order to scan topology, infiltrate servers and move laterally.
falsepositives: OCS/Lync/Skype administrator updating server configuration or topology
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4728 OR EventID=4756 OR EventID=4732) AND (TargetUserName='CSHelpDesk' OR TargetUserName='CSLocationAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='CSPersistentChatAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='CSResponseGroupAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='CSResponseGroupManager' OR TargetUserName='CSViewOnlyAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='CSVoiceAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='RTCComponentUniversalServices' OR TargetUserName='RTCProxyUniversalServices' OR TargetUserName='RTCSBAUniversalServices' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalConfigReplicator' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalGlobalReadOnlyGroup' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalReadOnlyAdmins' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalServerReadOnlyGroup' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalUserAdmins' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalUserReadOnlyGroup'))
title: New member added to a "OCS/Lync/Skype for Business" administration group (low risk)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker remotely dump LSASS credentials using the LSASSY tool.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%comsvcs.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((ParentCommandLine='rundll32.exe' OR ParentCommandLine='comsvcs.dll') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%comsvcs.dll%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: LSASS credential dump with LSASSY (process)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to create an IFM image (usually used for deploying domain controllers to reduce replication traffic) for dumping credentials.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ntdsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dsdbutil.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ntdsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dsdbutil.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ifm%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% i %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% c %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%activate%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%instance%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ntds%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ac %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ntds%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: IFM creation detected from commandline (installation from media)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to delete existing Windows native backup by reducing the allocated backup storage.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\vssadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%resize%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%shadowstorage%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows native backup size re-configuration

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker update the Service Principal Name (SPN) of a computer account in order to perform "Kerberos redirection" and escalate privileges.
falsepositives: Rare administrator modifications on computer objects
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-spn modification of a computer account.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4742 AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' AND ServicePrincipalNames='-' AND ServicePrincipalNames LIKE '%GC/%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Suspicious modification of a computer account SPN

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enumerate the domain password policy with native commands or tools like CME (--pass-pol).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4661 AND ProcessName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectServer='Security Account Manager' AND ObjectName LIKE 'DC=%' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectType LIKE 'SAM\_DOMAIN' ESCAPE '\' AND (Properties LIKE '%c7407360-20bf-11d0-a768-00aa006e0529%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf9679a4-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf9679a5-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf9679a6-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf9679bb-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf9679c2-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf9679c3-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf967a09-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf967a0b-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\' AND Properties LIKE '%bf967977-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Domain password policy enumeration

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker manipulate a computer object and updates its attribute 'msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity' to enable a resource to impersonate and authenticate any domain user.
falsepositives: Computer account set for delegation by a sysadmin
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-computer account set for RBCD delegation.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5136 AND DSType LIKE '\%\%14676' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectClass='computer' AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity')
title: Computer account manipulation for delegation (RBCD)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempt to dump DPAPI credentials (Windows Vault, Chrome, RDP, WiFi, Emails, ...) or registry hives via network share via tools like DonPAPI.
filename: windows-os/win-os-dump credentials (protected with DPAPI) via network share.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\C$' ESCAPE '\' AND (RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Wlansvc\\Profiles\\Interfaces\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\config\\SECURITY%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\config\\SOFTWARE%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\config\\SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Vault\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Vault\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\config\\systemprofile\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Vault\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\config\\systemprofile\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Protect\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\Microsoft\\Protect\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Credentials (protected by DPAPI) dump via network share

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to create a service for persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service creation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to change Defender default action to allow any threats
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Microsoft Defender default action changed to allow any threat (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker will dump the LSASS memory content using tools like Mimikatz, ProcDump, TaskMgr, ...
filename: windows-lsass/win-os-LSASS process accessed by a non system account.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4656 OR EventID=4663) AND ObjectType='Process' AND ObjectServer='Security' AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\System32\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' AND (ProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\SwReporter\\%\\software\_reporter\_tool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform*' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\Program Files\\Windows Defender Advanced Threat Protection*' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\system32\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\system32\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0)))
title: LSASS process dump by a non system account

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to change Defender default action to allow any threats
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%UnknownThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ThreatIDDefaultAction\_Actions%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender default action changed to allow any threat (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the configuration of a service to trigger an action when the service is crashed.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with backdoored command failure (Reg via PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service abuse with backdoored "command failure" (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker compromise a server with high privileges to perform permissions changes. Note that a dedicated rule for Exchange exists.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='ntSecurityDescriptor' AND OperationType LIKE '\%\%14674' ESCAPE '\' AND SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\')
title: Computer account modifying Active Directory permissions

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker exploit the PrintNightmare vulnerability by abusing the Windows print spooler using the service exposed by Gentilkiwi
filename: windows-os/win-os-SystemNightmare by GentilKiwi - external printer mapped (command).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%net use%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%printnightmare.gentilkiwi.com%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4648 AND (TargetUserName='gentilguest' OR TargetServerName='printnightmare.gentilkiwi.com' OR TargetInfo='printnightmare.gentilkiwi.com')))
title: SystemNightmare by GentilKiwi - External printer mapped (CVE-2021-1675 / CVE-2021-34527)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disable Defender security service. If tamper protection is enabled, this action may not work.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disabled%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Sense%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MpsSvc%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Microsoft Defender service deactivation attempt (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modifies the registry configuration in order to enable or downgrade NTLM protocol version, to later on perform relay attacks.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa\\LmCompatibilityLevel' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%0x00000000%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%0x00000001%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%0x00000002%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: NTLM downgrade attack (Reg via SYSMON)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to delete or resize existing VSS backup.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vssadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%shadows%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%resize%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%shadowstorage%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: VSS backup deletion or resize

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where APT actors exploits Fortinet vulnerabilities to gain access into Windows infrastructure.
filename: windows-os/win-os-Fortinet APT group abuse on Windows (user).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4720 AND (TargetUserName='elie' OR TargetUserName='WADGUtilityAccount'))
title: Fortinet APT group abuse on Windows (user)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modifies the "configuration" partition in order to obfuscate sneaky changes that will allow him to introduce a stealthy AdminSDholder backdoor.
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-extended rights backdoor obfuscation (via localizationDisplayId attr.).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5136 AND OperationType LIKE '\%\%14674' ESCAPE '\' AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='localizationDisplayId' AND ObjectDN LIKE '%CN=Extended-Rights,CN=Configuration%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Extended rights backdoor obfuscation (via localizationDisplayId attribute)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the configuration of a service to trigger an action when the service is crashed.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with backdoored command failure (service).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%failure%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%command%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Service abuse with backdoored "command failure" (service)

author: Markus Neis/@Karneades, adapted by mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker WMIimplant
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((EventID=4688 AND Version=2 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=1 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine='-'), 0))))
title: WMI spwaning PowerShell process - WMImplant

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to disable Defender security features in PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Payload LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND EventData LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisableInboundConnectionFiltering%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Microsoft Defender critical security components disabled (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier (adapted from Nasreddine Bencherchali)
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to register a SIP or trust provider in order to mislead signature validation checks.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography\\Providers\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography\\OID\\EncodingType%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Cryptography\\Providers\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Cryptography\\OID\\EncodingType%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\$dll%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious SIP or trust provider registration

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Help to detect scenarios where an attacker exploit the Mimispool print driver to escalate privileges.
filename: windows-os/win-os-printer spool driver from Mimikatz installed (PrintNightMare).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PrintService/Admin' AND EventID=808 AND PluginDllName LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\') OR (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PrintService/Admin' AND EventID=354 AND Param2 LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\') OR ((EventID=321 AND Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PrintService/Operational') AND (Param1 LIKE '%mimispool%' ESCAPE '\' OR Param2 LIKE '%printnightmare.gentilkiwi.com%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Mimispool printer driver installation (PrintNightmare vulnerability - CVE-2021-36958)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker remotely dump LSASS credentials using the LSASSY tool.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\%\\C$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE 'Windows%' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE '%.dmp' ESCAPE '\')
title: LSASS credential dump with LSASSY (admin share)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modifies host delegation settings for privilege escalation.
falsepositives: Rare administrator modifying host delegation settings
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-Kerberos constrained delegation settings changed (Rubeus) - Kerberos.yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4742 AND UserAccountControl='-') AND (NOT COALESCE((AllowedToDelegateTo='-'), 0)))
title: Host constrained delegation settings changed for potential abuse (Rubeus) - Kerberos only

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects if a member is added to a domain group via PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Identity%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%-Members%' ESCAPE '\')) OR EventID='4103 - ''Add-ADGroupMember'' - ''-Identity'' - ''-Members''' OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Identity%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Members%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Domain group membership change

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to dump Group Managed Services account (GMSA) passwords stored on writable domain controllers.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4662 AND ObjectServer='DS' AND ObjectType='msKds-ProvRootKey') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserSid='S-1-5-18'), 0)))
title: Group Managed Service Accounts password dump - GoldenGMSA

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts enumerate the audit policy in place.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\auditpol.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%get%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%backup%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Audit policy enumerated

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker reset or synchronize with another domain account the DSRM (Directory Services Restore Mode) password in order to escalate privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REG ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DsrmAdminLogonBehavior%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: DSRM password changed (Reg via command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker adds its account into a sensitive Exchange group to obtain "Replicating Directory Changes /all" and perform DCsync attack.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4728 OR EventID=4756 OR EventID=4732) AND (TargetUserName='Exchange Trusted Subsystem' OR TargetUserName='Exchange Windows Permissions'))
title: Exchange group membership change to perform DCsync attack

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker calls the stickey key and execute CMD.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=1 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Hashes LIKE '%99AE9C73E9BEE6F9C76D6F4093A9882DF06832CF%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%8C5437CD76A89EC983E3B364E219944DA3DAB464%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%8DCA9749CD48D286950E7A9FA1088C937CBCCAD4%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%F1EFB0FDDC156E4C61C5F78A54700E4E7984D55D%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Stickey key called CMD via command execution (hash detection)

author: Emir Erdogan (shortly adapted by mdecrevoisier)
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker abuse the printer spooler features to load a DLL. The attack is composed by 4 steps > 1) create a printer that points to a missing DLL 2) print to that port 3) crash the printer spool 4) have his original DLL registered for privilege escalation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventData LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Print spooler privilege escalation via printer added (CVE-2020-1048)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to load an artifact in the Exchange transport agent.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR EventData LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Exchange transport agent installation artifacts (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to enable Wdgiest authention so passwords are stored in clear text and can be dumped.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SecurityProviders\\WDigest\\UseLogonCredential' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%0x00000001%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Wdigest authentication enabled (registry)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to create a service for persistence.
