rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service creation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module via Global Assembly cache (GAC) manipulation.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
filename: windows-iis/win-iis-web module loaded via GAC manipulation (PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GacInstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Webserver IIS module installed via GAC manipulation (PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the original service executable path with a malicious one.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to deploy an IIS module.
falsepositives: New modules deployed on IIS Web servers, but also Exchange and ADCS servers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%module%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Webserver IIS module installed (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker modify the original service executable path with a malicious one.
filename: windows-services/win-os-service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via PowerShell).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=800 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service abuse with malicious ImagePath (Reg via PowerShell)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker configure the Windows firewall to allow incoming connections to perform stealthy lateral movement.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%localport=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%netsh%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%portopening%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%22%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: OpenSSH server firewall configuration on Windows (command)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker set an account with Kerberos pre-authentication not required to perform offline brutforce. Account with this status can be checked with the following command > "Get-ADUser -Filter 'useraccountcontrol -band 4194304' -Properties useraccountcontrol".
filename: windows-active_directory/win-ad-user set with Kerberos pre-authentication not required (AS-REP Roasting).yaml
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4738 AND UserAccountControl LIKE '\%\%2096' ESCAPE '\')
title: Account set with Kerberos pre-authentication not required (AS-REP Roasting)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to modify the Hosts file to perform DNS interception and/or redirect network traffic.
falsepositives: Administrator activity, web servers configuration, malware blocking attempt during incident response
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=11 AND TargetFilename LIKE '%\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts' ESCAPE '\')
title: DNS hosts file modified

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to register the SMBexec service to estasblish persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\BTOBTO\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Impacket SMBexec service creation (registry)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where a new member is added to a sensitive administration group related to OCS/Lync/Skype for Business in order to scan topology, infiltrate servers and move laterally.
falsepositives: OCS/Lync/Skype administrator updating server configuration or topology
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4728 OR EventID=4756 OR EventID=4732) AND (TargetUserName='CSAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='CSServerAdministrator' OR TargetUserName='RTCUniversalServerAdmins'))
title: New member added to an "OCS/Lync/Skype for Business" administration group (high risk)

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attemps to create an IFM for dumping credentials.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\diskshadow.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-s%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Diskshadow command abuse to expose VSS backup

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to delete existing Windows native backup (only available on Windows Server).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%wbadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows native backup deletion

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker attempts to clear the event logs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((EventID=800 AND (EventData LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4103 AND (Payload LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LogName%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Event log clear attempt (PowerShell)

author: Florian Roth (shortly adapted my mdecrevoisier)
description: Detects scenarios where a DLL is loaded by the DNS server in order to escalate privileges or initiate a remote shell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dnscmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/serverlevelplugindll%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: DLL ServerLevelPluginDll command installation

author: Florian Roth (shortly adapted my mdecrevoisier)
description: Detects scenarios where a DLL is loaded by the DNS server in order to escalate privileges or initiate a remote shell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='DNS Server' AND (EventID=770 OR EventID=150)
title: DLL ServerLevelPluginDll registration ("serverlevelplugindll" feature abuse)

author: Florian Roth (shortly adapted my mdecrevoisier)
description: Detects scenarios where a DLL is loaded by the DNS server in order to escalate privileges or initiate a remote shell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\services\\DNS\\Parameters\\ServerLevelPluginDll' ESCAPE '\')
title: DLL ServerLevelPluginDll registration (Reg via Sysmon)
